name: PiLp.norm_eq_of_L1
type: {ι : Type u} → [Fintype ι] → {β : ι → Type v} → [∀ i, SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)] → (x : PiLp 1 β) → ‖x‖ = ∑ i : ι, ‖x i‖
provides: The finite L1 product norm equals the sum of coordinate norms, giving the full sum-of-absolute-coefficients penalty for real vectors.
